name: PM-KISAN
benefit: ₹6,000 per year, paid in 3 installments directly to your bank account
explanation_template: Landholding farmers receive direct income support in three installments a year.

name: Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY
benefit: ₹5,00,000 health cover per family, per year, cashless at listed hospitals
explanation_template: Households below the income threshold get cashless hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh a year.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove
explanation_template: Women from low-income households get a free gas connection, no security deposit required.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (Old Age Pension)
benefit: ₹200–500 monthly pension credited directly to your account
explanation_template: Senior citizens within the income limit receive a monthly pension.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
benefit: Subsidy of 15–35% on projects up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (services)
explanation_template: Aspiring entrepreneurs above 18 can get a subsidized loan to start a small business.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High-interest savings account for a girl child, maturing at age 21
explanation_template: Parents of a girl child under 10 can open a high-interest government savings account in her name.

name: National Disability Pension Scheme
benefit: ₹300–500 monthly pension for persons with 80%+ disability
explanation_template: Persons with a registered disability and income under the limit receive a monthly pension.

name: Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Scheme
benefit: Medical assistance, education scholarships for children, and accident cover
explanation_template: Registered construction workers in Maharashtra get medical, education, and accident benefits.
